projects.name: South Texas Project Nuclear Generating Station
projects.quote: In alignment with our capital and strategic plan, on November 1, 2023 we completed our acquisition of a 44% undivided ownership interest in the South Texas Project Nuclear Generating Station, a 2,645-megawatt, dual-unit nuclear plant located about 90 miles southwest of Houston, for $1.75 billion .

projects.name: LaSalle Clean Energy Center nuclear-powered clean hydrogen production facility (MachH2)
projects.location: LaSalle Clean Energy Center in Illinois
projects.quote: We estimate the facility will cost approximately $900 million, with a portion of the MachH2 award offsetting the project’s cost.

projects.name: Microsoft Virginia data center carbon-free nuclear energy agreement
projects.quote: This agreement follows a similar deal between Constellation and Microsoft announced in the second quarter of 2023 to power one of its Virginia data centers with nearly 100 percent carbon-free nuclear energy.

projects.name: ComEd hourly carbon-free nuclear energy matching agreement
projects.quote: We signed a historic agreement with Commonwealth Edison (ComEd) to power its 54 metered facilities with locally produced carbon-free nuclear energy, every hour of every day.
